name: CrowdStrike Falcon: contain host
description: Run from a case: look up the case's host in Falcon by hostname and request network containment, then record both HTTP statuses in a case note. A case without a hostname gets a note instead.

params.label: Falcon API host
params.help: Your Falcon cloud's API host: api.crowdstrike.com (US-1), api.us-2.crowdstrike.com (US-2), api.eu-1.crowdstrike.com (EU-1) or api.laggar.gcw.crowdstrike.com (US-GOV-1). Host only, no https://.

secrets.name: FALCON_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Falcon API client ID (Support and resources > API clients and keys).

secrets.name: FALCON_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Falcon API client secret, shown once when the client is created.

setup:
## Falcon side
1. API client (**Support and resources > API clients and keys**) with **Hosts: Read** and **Hosts: Write**. The same client as *CrowdStrike Falcon: pull alerts* works if it also has these scopes.
2. Secrets `FALCON_CLIENT_ID` and `FALCON_CLIENT_SECRET`, allowed for your API host.
3. The host's prevention policy must allow network containment (Falcon blocks containment of some server roles unless enabled).

## Case side
The target host is the case's `hostname` attribute: create the custom artifact type `hostname` (Settings > Artifact types) and add the host to the case (the *EDR alerts to case* template does this). Without it, the newest CrowdStrike alert promoted into the case is used (`device.hostname`).

## How it works
- `find`: `GET /devices/queries/devices/v1?filter=hostname:'<host>'&limit=2` (FQL, URL-encoded). Hostnames containing a quote or backslash are refused.
- `contain`: only when exactly one device matches, `POST /devices/entities/devices-actions/v2?action_name=contain` with `{"ids": [<device id>]}`. Falcon answers 202 when the request is accepted; containment completes when the sensor checks in.
- A note records the lookup and contain statuses. Lift containment from the Falcon console (or `action_name=lift_containment`).

Docs relied on:
- OAuth2 token (`POST /oauth2/token`, returns **201** with `access_token`, `expires_in` 1799 s): https://developer.crowdstrike.com/api-reference/collections/oauth2/
- Alerts (`GET /alerts/queries/alerts/v2`, `POST /alerts/entities/alerts/v2` with `composite_ids`): https://developer.crowdstrike.com/api-reference/collections/alerts/
- Hosts (`GET /devices/queries/devices/v1`, `POST /devices/entities/devices-actions/v2?action_name=contain`): https://developer.crowdstrike.com/api-reference/collections/hosts/
- Alert FQL fields (`created_timestamp`, `severity` 1-100 bands, `composite_id`, `device.hostname`): https://github.com/CrowdStrike/falcon-mcp/blob/main/falcon_mcp/resources/detections.py

## Containment guardrails
A **containment guard** step runs before the action: targets protected in **Settings → Integrations → Containment guardrails** (VIPs, domain controllers, critical ranges) are never contained automatically, and the tenant's daily and per-case caps apply. A refusal stops the run and adds a case note; every action is listed on the case under **Artifacts & assets → Containment**, where an analyst marks it released once undone.

config.expression: (case.attributes.get('hostname', '') or ((alert.payload.get('device') or {}).get('hostname') or '' if alert and alert.source == 'crowdstrike' and alert.payload is mapping else '')) | length > 0 and (case.attributes.get('hostname', '') or ((alert.payload.get('device') or {}).get('hostname') or '' if alert and alert.source == 'crowdstrike' and alert.payload is mapping else '')) | length < 256 and "'" not in (case.attributes.get('hostname', '') or ((alert.payload.get('device') or {}).get('hostname') or '' if alert and alert.source == 'crowdstrike' and alert.payload is mapping else '')) and '\\' not in (case.attributes.get('hostname', '') or ((alert.payload.get('device') or {}).get('hostname') or '' if alert and alert.source == 'crowdstrike' and alert.payload is mapping else ''))

config.content: Falcon containment not sent: this case has no hostname. Add a `hostname` artifact and run the workflow again.

config.url: https://%%FALCON_API_HOST%%/devices/queries/devices/v1?filter={{ ("hostname:'" ~ (case.attributes.get('hostname', '') or ((alert.payload.get('device') or {}).get('hostname') or '' if alert and alert.source == 'crowdstrike' and alert.payload is mapping else '')) ~ "'") | urlencode }}&limit=2

config.expression: steps.find.output.status == 200 and steps.find.output.body is mapping and (steps.find.output.body.get('resources') or []) | length == 1

config.content: Falcon containment not sent for {{ (case.attributes.get('hostname', '') or ((alert.payload.get('device') or {}).get('hostname') or '' if alert and alert.source == 'crowdstrike' and alert.payload is mapping else '')) }}: device lookup HTTP {{ steps.find.output.status }}, {{ ((steps.find.output.body.get('resources') or []) if steps.find.output.body is mapping else []) | length }} matching devices (exactly one is required).

Falcon network containment requested for {{ (case.attributes.get('hostname', '') or ((alert.payload.get('device') or {}).get('hostname') or '' if alert and alert.source == 'crowdstrike' and alert.payload is mapping else '')) }} (device {{ steps.find.output.body.resources[0] }}): device lookup HTTP {{ steps.find.output.status }}, contain HTTP {{ steps.contain.output.status }}{{ ' (accepted)' if steps.contain.output.status in [200, 202] else ' (not accepted: check the Hosts: Write scope and the response in the run history)' }}.

config.target: {{ (case.attributes.get('hostname', '') or ((alert.payload.get('device') or {}).get('hostname') or '' if alert and alert.source == 'crowdstrike' and alert.payload is mapping else '')) }}
